approval_model.subject: Elected MLA, Uttarpara AC 185
approval_model.method: Beta-binomial (Bayesian) estimate. Prior: the 2026 vote share, weighted as 20 pseudo-responses so that real feedback quickly dominates. Evidence: resident feedback classified as approve / disapprove / neutral (neutral excluded). Output: posterior mean with an 80% credible interval. When the feedback register is live, free-text feedback is classified by an AI model before it enters this calculation.
approval_model.caveat: Vote share measures support at one election, not approval of performance. Until real, consented resident feedback is collected, this estimate is a demonstration of the method only.
